name: TranscriptLine
description: A manually edited or provider-generated speech line, sound-event marker, or timestamp within a session

kind.description: Line kind: speech, marker, or timestamp

speaker_label.description: Editable speaker label for speech lines

text.description: Current editable line text or lower-case bracketed event tag

start_ms.description: Full-session source-relative start time in milliseconds when supplied

end_ms.description: Full-session source-relative end time in milliseconds when supplied

source_segment_id.description: AudioSegment that produced this line, when generated

provider_speaker_id.description: Provider speaker identity before manual relabeling

raw_text.description: Original provider or manually captured text retained for review

confidence.description: Average provider confidence for this generated line

provider_start_ms.description: Provider-relative start time in milliseconds when supplied

provider_end_ms.description: Provider-relative end time in milliseconds when supplied

edited_at.description: ISO timestamp when staff or cleanup last changed this line

cleanup_text.description: Latest accepted AI cleanup text, without replacing raw_text

cleanup_applied.description: Whether a reviewed cleanup proposal was applied

audio_event_tags.description: Provider-returned bracketed sound-event tags retained on a line

automatic_marker.description: True when this marker was generated from a provider-timed audio event

audio_event_source.description: Event marker source: provider, vad, or manual

audio_event_type.description: Normalized provider event type without changing the displayed bracket tag

audio_event_confidence.description: Optional provider confidence for an automatic event marker
